# jlib's components

76 components, by level. Each links to its reference: properties, events, slots, methods, styling and
examples. In an app, the declarations of the installed version are the last word:
`node_modules/@syware/jlib/dist/<level>/<tag>.d.ts`. One missing from `dist` is newer than the installed jlib.

## Atoms

- **App icon** ([`JlAppIcon`, `jl-app-icon`](components/jl-app-icon.md)): An app's own icon: its glyph in white on the brand's blue, one family for every SyWare app.
- **Avatar** ([`JlAvatar`, `jl-avatar`](components/jl-avatar.md)): A person, a team or a bot: a picture, or initials on a colour their name picks.
- **Badge** ([`JlBadge`, `jl-badge`](components/jl-badge.md)): A short status, coloured by its tone.
- **Button** ([`JlButton`, `jl-button`](components/jl-button.md)): A button for actions, from the main one of a page to quiet ones in a toolbar.
- **Checkbox** ([`JlCheckbox`, `jl-checkbox`](components/jl-checkbox.md)): A box to tick, with its label beside it.
- **Chip** ([`JlChip`, `jl-chip`](components/jl-chip.md)): A compact token: a filter to turn on and off, a tag to take away, or a label.
- **Divider** ([`JlDivider`, `jl-divider`](components/jl-divider.md)): A line between groups of content, across or up and down, with an optional label.
- **Icon** ([`JlIcon`, `jl-icon`](components/jl-icon.md)): A lucide icon by name, sized in pixels and coloured by its text.
- **Input** ([`JlInput`, `jl-input`](components/jl-input.md)): A single-line text field that takes part in forms.
- **Kbd** ([`JlKbd`, `jl-kbd`](components/jl-kbd.md)): A keyboard shortcut, one keycap per key, written the way the platform does.
- **Link** ([`JlLink`, `jl-link`](components/jl-link.md)): A link in text, a list or a footer, with safe external links.
- **Loading bar** ([`JlLoadingBar`, `jl-loading-bar`](components/jl-loading-bar.md)): A thin line that says something is on its way: nothing for a moment, then growing, never at the end.
- **Progress** ([`JlProgress`, `jl-progress`](components/jl-progress.md)): A bar that shows how much of a task is done, or that work goes on.
- **Progress ring** ([`JlProgressRing`, `jl-progress-ring`](components/jl-progress-ring.md)): A ring that shows how much of a task is done, for small places.
- **Rating** ([`JlRating`, `jl-rating`](components/jl-rating.md)): A row of stars to give a score, or to show one.
- **Select** ([`JlSelect`, `jl-select`](components/jl-select.md)): A choice among a list, on the browser's own select.
- **Skeleton** ([`JlSkeleton`, `jl-skeleton`](components/jl-skeleton.md)): A shimmering placeholder in the shape of content that is loading.
- **Slider** ([`JlSlider`, `jl-slider`](components/jl-slider.md)): A number picked by dragging along a track that fills in the accent colour.
- **Spinner** ([`JlSpinner`, `jl-spinner`](components/jl-spinner.md)): A turning ring for work in progress.
- **Switch** ([`JlSwitch`, `jl-switch`](components/jl-switch.md)): An on/off setting that applies at once.
- **Textarea** ([`JlTextarea`, `jl-textarea`](components/jl-textarea.md)): A text field of several lines that can grow with its text and count its characters.

## Molecules

- **Accordion** ([`JlAccordion`, `jl-accordion`](components/jl-accordion.md)): A list of sections that open under their headings, one at a time or several.
- **Accordion item** ([`JlAccordionItem`, `jl-accordion-item`](components/jl-accordion-item.md)): A section that opens and closes under its heading: a disclosure, or one item of an accordion.
- **Account button** ([`JlAccountButton`, `jl-account-button`](components/jl-account-button.md)): The person signed in, in the frame of an app: avatar, name and role, opening their account.
- **Alert** ([`JlAlert`, `jl-alert`](components/jl-alert.md)): A message in the page, coloured by its tone: a tip, a success, a warning, a failure.
- **Avatar group** ([`JlAvatarGroup`, `jl-avatar-group`](components/jl-avatar-group.md)): A few people at a glance: overlapping avatars, and a count for the others.
- **Breadcrumb** ([`JlBreadcrumb`, `jl-breadcrumb`](components/jl-breadcrumb.md)): Where a page sits in a hierarchy: a trail of links that ends with the current page.
- **Calendar** ([`JlCalendar`, `jl-calendar`](components/jl-calendar.md)): A month grid to pick a day, in any locale, from the pointer or the keyboard.
- **Card** ([`JlCard`, `jl-card`](components/jl-card.md)): A flat surface for one subject: heading, content, media, actions and a footer.
- **Chip group** ([`JlChipGroup`, `jl-chip-group`](components/jl-chip-group.md)): A row of chips to choose from: one, as radios, or several, each turned on and off.
- **Code block** ([`JlCodeBlock`, `jl-code-block`](components/jl-code-block.md)): Source code, coloured, with a button to copy it.
- **Combobox** ([`JlCombobox`, `jl-combobox`](components/jl-combobox.md)): A text field with a list of options that narrows as people type.
- **Copy button** ([`JlCopyButton`, `jl-copy-button`](components/jl-copy-button.md)): Copies a text to the clipboard, and says so.
- **Date picker** ([`JlDatePicker`, `jl-date-picker`](components/jl-date-picker.md)): A date field that shows the date for people and opens a calendar to pick it.
- **Empty state** ([`JlEmpty`, `jl-empty`](components/jl-empty.md)): What a list, a table or a page shows when it has nothing yet, and the way to fill it.
- **Facts** ([`JlFacts`, `jl-facts`](components/jl-facts.md)): The facts about one thing, label and value, the ones without a value left out.
- **Field** ([`JlField`, `jl-field`](components/jl-field.md)): A control with its label, a hint and an error message.
- **File drop** ([`JlFileDrop`, `jl-file-drop`](components/jl-file-drop.md)): A zone to drop files on or browse for them, with the chosen files listed under it.
- **Input list** ([`JlInputList`, `jl-input-list`](components/jl-input-list.md)): A field with several values, each in its own row, added and removed.
- **List item** ([`JlListItem`, `jl-list-item`](components/jl-list-item.md)): A row of a list: icon or avatar, heading, description, a note and trailing controls.
- **Load more** ([`JlLoadMore`, `jl-load-more`](components/jl-load-more.md)): The end of a long list: how much shows, and a button for the next page.
- **Load state** ([`JlLoadState`, `jl-load-state`](components/jl-load-state.md)): What a list shows while its data comes, when there is none, and when it failed to come.
- **Menu** ([`JlMenu`, `jl-menu`](components/jl-menu.md)): A list of actions that opens from a button, driven by the pointer or entirely by the keyboard.
- **Number input** ([`JlNumberInput`, `jl-number-input`](components/jl-number-input.md)): A number field with − and + buttons, arrow keys and bounds.
- **Pagination** ([`JlPagination`, `jl-pagination`](components/jl-pagination.md)): Moves through pages of results, with the current page, its neighbours and the ends a click away.
- **Popover** ([`JlPopover`, `jl-popover`](components/jl-popover.md)): A floating panel that opens from a button: a small form, settings or details, closed by a click outside.
- **Radio group** ([`JlRadioGroup`, `jl-radio-group`](components/jl-radio-group.md)): One choice among a few, all in view, as radios or as cards.
- **Search** ([`JlSearch`, `jl-search`](components/jl-search.md)): A search field that waits for a pause in the typing, with a keyboard shortcut.
- **Search button** ([`JlSearchButton`, `jl-search-button`](components/jl-search-button.md)): What opens the command palette: a search field to press, with its keys.
- **Segmented control** ([`JlSegmented`, `jl-segmented`](components/jl-segmented.md)): A few exclusive choices in a row, with a thumb that slides to the chosen one.
- **Stat** ([`JlStat`, `jl-stat`](components/jl-stat.md)): A key figure with its label, its change and a sparkline of recent values.
- **Steps** ([`JlSteps`, `jl-steps`](components/jl-steps.md)): The steps of a process and where people are: done, current, and still to come.
- **Tab panel** ([`JlTabPanel`, `jl-tab-panel`](components/jl-tab-panel.md)): One panel of a jl-tabs: its content, and the label, icon and badge of its tab.
- **Tabs** ([`JlTabs`, `jl-tabs`](components/jl-tabs.md)): Tabs over panels of content: one panel shows at a time, the others a click or an arrow key away.
- **Tag input** ([`JlTagInput`, `jl-tag-input`](components/jl-tag-input.md)): A field that collects short texts as removable chips.
- **Timeline** ([`JlTimeline`, `jl-timeline`](components/jl-timeline.md)): What happened, in order, along a vertical line with markers coloured by tone.
- **Toast** ([`JlToast`, `jl-toast`](components/jl-toast.md)): A short notification that something happened, with an optional action, that can close by itself.
- **Tooltip** ([`JlTooltip`, `jl-tooltip`](components/jl-tooltip.md)): A short hint in a dark bubble, shown when the pointer rests on its trigger or the keyboard reaches it.

## Organisms

- **Command palette** ([`JlCommandPalette`, `jl-command-palette`](components/jl-command-palette.md)): A search box over every command of an app, opened by ⌘K or Ctrl+K, with fuzzy matching, and the app's own results for what was typed.
- **Confirm** ([`JlConfirm`, `jl-confirm`](components/jl-confirm.md)): A yes-or-no question in a small modal, and confirmDialog() to ask it with await.
- **Dialog** ([`JlDialog`, `jl-dialog`](components/jl-dialog.md)): A modal window over the page, for a task or a decision that needs full attention.
- **Drawer** ([`JlDrawer`, `jl-drawer`](components/jl-drawer.md)): A panel that slides over the page from an edge, for a task beside the page rather than in place of it.
- **Flow** ([`JlFlow`, `jl-flow`](components/jl-flow.md)): Nodes joined by edges, to move, connect and extend: a workflow editor.
- **Navbar** ([`JlNavbar`, `jl-navbar`](components/jl-navbar.md)): The bar at the top of an app: brand, main links and actions, folding its links on a narrow width.
- **Page header** ([`JlPageHeader`, `jl-page-header`](components/jl-page-header.md)): The top of a page: breadcrumb, heading, description, actions and a row of badges.
- **Page outlet** ([`JlPageOutlet`, `jl-page-outlet`](components/jl-page-outlet.md)): Where the pages show: the next one loads out of sight, under a line, and shows once it has its data.
- **Side nav** ([`JlSideNav`, `jl-side-nav`](components/jl-side-nav.md)): The navigation down the side of an app, with nested items and a collapsed rail.
- **Tab bar** ([`JlTabBar`, `jl-tab-bar`](components/jl-tab-bar.md)): The bar along the bottom of a phone: the main places of an app, one tap away.
- **Table** ([`JlTable`, `jl-table`](components/jl-table.md)): Rows of records under column headings, with sorting, selection, rows that open on their details, formats and a sticky header.
- **Toaster** ([`JlToaster`, `jl-toaster`](components/jl-toaster.md)): The corner of the window where toasts stack, and toast() to show one from anywhere.
- **Tree** ([`JlTree`, `jl-tree`](components/jl-tree.md)): Nested items that open and close, as files in folders, with the keyboard of a tree; loaded a page at a time for large ones.

## Templates

- **App shell** ([`JlAppShell`, `jl-app-shell`](components/jl-app-shell.md)): The frame of an app: top bar, sidebar, scrolling main area and side panel, with a drawer and a tab bar when narrow.
- **Auth layout** ([`JlAuthLayout`, `jl-auth-layout`](components/jl-auth-layout.md)): The sign-in screen every SyWare app shares: the brand on a dark panel, the form beside it.
- **Page** ([`JlPage`, `jl-page`](components/jl-page.md)): A page of an app: its header with a named back link, then its content at one of four widths.
- **Split view** ([`JlSplitView`, `jl-split-view`](components/jl-split-view.md)): Two panes with a divider to drag between them, side by side or stacked.
- **Stack** ([`JlStack`, `jl-stack`](components/jl-stack.md)): Its children one under the other, with one space between them: the layout of a form.
